items.headline: Sources: 49ers Pro Bowl FB Juszczyk (knee) expected out 2-3 weeks
items.description: 49ers Pro Bowl fullback Kyle Juszczyk suffered a knee sprain and bone bruise and is expected to be sidelined for two to three weeks, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.
